validation: Built from uncommitted changes on top of de14979. The same working tree (one QR hint wording change earlier) ran over USB on two Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B boards (chip rev 1.3, 32 MB): site Wi-Fi, M31 polling, native Dashboard, Setup hub and Firmware Update page verified. This exact image was not separately installed before publishing.
notes: P4-LCD only (Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B). Native touchscreen Dashboard with site logo, status pills, sparklines and Devices summary; Setup hub with live capability status and Firmware Update tile; one-shot ESP32-C6 hosted update to 2.12.13. Application-only image: preserves the installed bootloader and saved configuration. Boards still on another vendor or factory partition layout need a one-time USB install with the RIOT OTA partition table.
